title: Mapping R2DBC results by property or constructor name
summary: Both new R2DBC mappers read the row. Strict constructor mapping nevertheless rejected a complete one-property result.

change.description: The five submitted commits landed together as two new mapper classes and two test classes. R2DBC clients can pass a Spring Function to map driver-provided Row or OutParameters objects to a Java type.

notes: The projections run on R2DBC H2. The caller is compiled with -parameters, reads the actual driver row and preserves the constructor-versus-setter distinction.
